science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Survive the Kp-8 magnetic shear storm.

sensory_palette.sight: Glints of bioluminescent spore-fog drift across the jagged basalt spires, illuminating the cresting waves of the ferrofluid sea in an eerie blue glow. The sheer scale of the cavern dwarfs the scaffolding.
sensory_palette.sound: The cavern echoes with the deafening, low-frequency roar of multi-tesla magnetic shears tearing across the metallic surface.
sensory_palette.smell: Ozone from static discharge mixes heavily with the sharp scent of raw copper.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: The metallic tang of electricity and raw iron dances heavily on the tongue.
sensory_palette.touch: Violent kinetic winds threaten to rip boots from their footing, while a piezo-electric hum resonates directly through teeth and bone.

interactive_features.affordance_description: A copper-reinforced spire vibrating intensely under the shear storm.
A deep trough carved by the magnetic shear, providing temporary cover.
A massive wheel requiring alignment against the magnetic flux.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To block incoming waves from destroying the catwalk.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: By deploying a temporary magnetic field.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The breaker is overheating due to the relentless shear forces.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The breaker shatters completely under the shear force, exposing the catwalk.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear is tearing at the ferrofluid sea's surface.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The shear threatens to rip the primary grounding mast from its basalt foundations.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: If the mast falls, the Enclave's power grid will be exposed to the full brunt of the Kp-8 magnetic storm.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: If the grounding shunt isn't stabilized, the lower catwalks will be flooded by a rogue ferrofluid wave, cutting off the escape route.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Kaio misjudges the magnetic flux completely, getting stuck.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Kaio stabilizes the anchor but loses footing, forcing a handoff.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Kaio locks the anchor and maps a new thermal vent.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Kaio desperately reaches out through the swirling shear to hand the physical baton over to Ryn as the catwalk shifts.
